description: Send a push campaign now, or schedule it with scheduledAt (future ISO 8601). Optionally deliver in each contact's local time (sendInRecipientTimezone + scheduledTimezone) or at each contact's optimal hour (sendTimeOptimization); omitted timing fields keep the draft's saved values. Delivers real notifications to every contact in the audience with an active device on a set-up platform. Confirm with the user before calling.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO 8601 time. Omit to send immediately.

scheduledTimezone.description: IANA zone the scheduled wall-clock time refers to, e.g. "America/New_York". null clears it.

sendInRecipientTimezone.description: Deliver scheduledAt's wall-clock time in each contact's own timezone (the device timezone the SDK reported, else the contact's timezone attribute). Needs scheduledAt and scheduledTimezone when sending. Zones whose time has passed get it right away; contacts with no known timezone get it at scheduledAt. Turns sendTimeOptimization off.

sendTimeOptimization.description: Send each contact the push at their most engaged hour: their push click history, else email open history, else the workspace's usual push hour (at least 20 clicks in 90 days), else the start time. Turns sendInRecipientTimezone off. Cannot be true together with sendInRecipientTimezone.

sendTimeWindowHours.description: Hours after the start (now, or scheduledAt) in which optimized sends may land, 1-24. Omit to keep the saved value (12 if never set).
